articles.summary: Sungrow is a global leader in solar and storage energy solutions, powering millions of homes with reliable, high-performance devices that produce clean energy. Now, together with Enode, they’re making it easier for households everywhere to connect, optimize, and take control of their energy. Through this partnership, Sungrow enables customers to connect their solar and storage devices to their preferred energy management apps. This gives them access to competitive tariffs and smart features that help optimize energy use and lower bills.
articles.title: Sungrow and Enode partner to make smart energy management more accessible

articles.summary: When we started Enode, we believed that connecting and optimising energy devices could meaningfully improve how the energy system works. Retailers have connected thousands of devices through Enode, but turning that potential into real flexibility has been a challenge. Flex changes that by giving teams one place to understand, shape and operate their flexible load. It’s a practical step toward using everyday devices to support a renewable grid.
articles.title: Meet Enode Flex: the flexibility platform for energy retailers

articles.summary: How one of the Netherlands’ largest energy suppliers built a smart charging product that works for every household — not just early adopters.
articles.title: Essent: Making smart charging work for everyone

articles.summary: 2025 was a big year for Enode. We partnered with more OEMs and energy companies than ever before. Customers launched services that are now live with millions of users. We shipped major new products. The team grew. And in November, we passed 500,000 connected energy devices on the platform. What matters most to us is how these things connect. Each partnership, product launch, and customer rollout moved us closer to the same goal we’ve been working toward from the start: making energy systems easier to build, easier to scale, and ready for flexibility.
articles.title: Looking back at 2025 at Enode
